course_title: Fresh Sem: Music: Artistry and Entrepreneurship
subject: MUS
course_description: Fulfills the freshman seminar requirement of the General Education Requirements. A variety of courses covering a wide range of topics in music. Refer to the Music Department website for a listing of classes currently offered.
course_notes: (Freshmen Seminar - Limited to First Year Students Only) (This course combines theoretical knowledge with practical, hands-on experiences, guiding students through the core aspects of artist entrepreneurship, including developing a unique artistic voice and identity, self-marketing, financial planning, project development, and audience/community engagement. Through a combination of lectures, case studies, guest artist discussions, and hands-on fieldwork, students will engage with real-world scenarios within the creative industry, ultimately crafting their own distinct contributions to the evolving landscape of artist-driven initiatives.)
